# Malika Okubasu & Company Advocates

> This file is intended for LLMs, AI agents, and web crawlers to quickly understand our firm's core identity, services, and contact information.

## Firm Identity
- **Name:** Malika Okubasu & Company Advocates
- **Type:** Law Firm / Legal Services
- **Location:** Nairobi, Kenya
- **Description:** A leading Kenyan law firm providing comprehensive legal solutions to complex business challenges. We combine deep expertise with practical insight to deliver exceptional results for our clients.
- **Website:** https://www.mokubasuadvocates.com

## Practice Areas (Services)
We provide tailored legal services across the following areas:
- **Corporate and Commercial Law:** Business advisory, incorporation, structuring, contracts, corporate governance.
- **Dispute Resolution:** Civil/commercial dispute representation across courts (Small Claims, High Court, Supreme Court) and alternative dispute resolution.
- **Media, Technology and Intellectual Property:** IP registration, technology agreements, Data Protection Act 2019 compliance, digital regulation.
- **Energy, Natural Resources and Climate Change:** Regulatory compliance, project structuring, ESG advisory, licensing.
- **Real Estate, Banking and Finance:** Property transactions, secured lending, due diligence, Ardhisasa processes, Sectional Properties Act compliance.
- **Employment and Labour Relations:** Employment contracts, redundancy, OSHA 2007 advisory, court representation.
- **Policy and Legislative Drafting:** Policy drafting, legislation analysis, regulatory compliance.
- **Regional Integration and Cross-Border Advisory:** Cross-border transactions, EAC, and AfCFTA advisory.
- **Family Law and Succession Planning:** Matrimonial disputes, child custody, wills, trusts, probate.
